column1: # languages.hymt.tsv - the app languages Hy-MT2 supports, code <TAB> prompt name.
# Names are the ENGLISH full names from the official Hy-MT2 supported-languages table
# (huggingface.co/tencent/Hy-MT2-7B), which the English prompt template expects: plain
# "Chinese" is the table's name for Simplified Chinese. Both Portuguese variants map to the
# table's single "Portuguese". A code absent here is not offered in the pickers for this
# family and a job naming it is refused (see family_prompt_lang_name).
